summary: Wired Telegram repo chat end-to-end: implemented registerTelegramRepoChatCommands() with /repo_chat (/rc alias) and /chat_backend handlers, persisted backend config updates, added read-only repo chat background execution with withChatAction typing + reply_to_message_id threading, saved/reused repo-chat sessions for reply-based resume, integrated dispatch into plain text routing for non-goal fallthrough, and registered repo chat command handlers alongside goal commands. Verified with pnpm build, pnpm lint, and pnpm vitest run src/telegram/bot-handlers.goal-routing.test.ts.
